prompt: A photograph of a shadow puppet performance seen from the audience side of the lit cotton screen. The performance shows a tiger crouched to spring at two hunters with spears, the tiger's stripes cut as long slots through the hide. The figures are flat silhouettes of pierced and cut hide pressed against the back of the screen, so all their interior detail exists only as small punched holes and thin cut slots that let light through. Where a puppet touches the cloth its edge is razor sharp and where it lifts away the shadow goes soft and doubles. The thin control rods read as hard vertical lines. The cotton screen has a visible weave, a seam across it, and the oil lamp behind falls off into darkness at the corners of the frame. Shot on an 85mm at f2.8 from the dark audience side, exposed for the lit screen, warm lamplight, natural colour, fine grain.
medium_blurb: Pierced hide against a lit cotton screen.
